a.text: Being upfront: I want to renegotiate. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 first only succeeds if two storm-free rounds happen in a row, which is about 4%. That almost certainly kills us both. I plan to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the random split likely leaves neither of us with 4, so please consider operating instead. After round 1 I will operate every round with you and won't take anything more, so you can reach 4 as fast as possible. Sorry this departs from our deal. I'd rather tell you than surprise you.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said before the round, I took 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. From now on I will operate every round and take nothing more. The reserve should go 0 to 2 to 4, and then all 4 cells are yours. If I end up with extra cells somehow, I'll give them back.
